# Bitbucket Cloud fixtures

Recorded 2026-09-28 from the public repository
`bitbucket.org/atlassianlabs/atlascode` through `api.bitbucket.org/2.0`,
anonymously, with small `pagelen` values: three open pull requests, three
finished (merged and declined), #1115 in full with its comments, and its head
commit's statuses.

There are no issue fixtures: Bitbucket Cloud answers its issue API with
`410 Gone` on every repository ("CHANGE-3071 - Functionality has been
deprecated"), so omatty reads no issues there (`ErrNoTracker`).

No token, no private repository, no email address.
